root_cause.text: A race condition in the SCTP diagnostic dump_one path where the association can be freed and marked dead after obtaining a transport reference but before acquiring the socket lock, causing subsequent functions to dereference already-freed association state (e.g., the bind address list).
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "the SCTP exact sock_diag lookup can hold a transport reference, block on lock_sock(sk), and then resume after sctp_association_free() has marked the association dead and freed its bind address list," leading to out-of-bounds reads when `inet_diag_msg_sctpasoc_fill()` reads the corrupted list. The patch fixes this by moving the validity check (`if (ep != assoc->ep || assoc->base.dead)`) after `lock_sock(sk)` and returning `-ESTALE`, preventing use of a torn association.
